summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for Customer Invoice Overview payment-row enhancement, export include_payments behavior, COO regression, paired-row UI behavior, hide-zero + toggle interactions, mobile/desktop overflow, and production build.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid namespace collision: non-table element uses `cio-row-count`, which overlaps row prefix `cio-row-*` and can break automated row selectors.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows repeated 401 requests to /api/auth/me before authentication and aborted telemetry/network requests (`cdn-cgi/rum`, transient aborted `/api/sales-roi-summary`).

action_items: Keep current backend implementation as-is for CIO payments (all tested contracts passed, including Bangalore fixture exact values and export include_payments true/false behavior).
Optionally rename `cio-row-count` to a non-row prefix test id (example: `cio-count-label`) to avoid selector collisions in automated testing.
Optionally reduce pre-auth console 401 noise from `/api/auth/me` if strict no-console-error policy is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Testability: avoid using the same data-testid prefix for both data rows and unrelated controls/labels (currently `cio-row-*` includes a non-row element).
Maintainability: `/app/backend/routes/accounting_transactions.py` is very large (>1700 lines); split into focused modules (sync, diagnostics, dashboard, export) to reduce regression blast radius.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest passed (3/3): row payment contract, global reconciliation, Bangalore fixture exact values [1111,0,0,0,5432,12345.5], payment_prev=500, payment_total=18888.5, payment_mom=6913.5, payment_count=4; export include_payments true has adjacent Invoice+Payment received rows and dual totals, include_payments false has invoice-only rows + single total. UI checks passed: payment toggle default ON each mount/reload, invoice/payment immediate sibling pairing, toggle OFF hides payment rows+payment footer+payment summary text, toggle ON restores, hide-zero behavior consistent, COO has no payment toggle/rows, column resize localStorage persistence/reset works, no body overflow at desktop/mobile, production build passed with warnings.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found in the requested payment-row feature scope. Remaining findings are non-functional: (1) selector namespace collision from `cio-row-count` sharing row prefix and (2) expected/known pre-auth 401 noise in console from auth bootstrap.
